context.transcript:
My name is Cindy Dawson and I'm a trainer at MacLeland's Gym.
Your management team asked me to talk to you about the wellness program we're offering to all full-time employees.
For only $15 a month, you'll have full access to our facility.
You must join the fitness center by May 30th in order to take advantage of these introductory rates.
I'm passing around a sign-up sheet.
If you're interested, please write your name and email address so I can send you information.
context.transcript_translation:
我叫 Cindy Dawson，是 MacLeland's Gym 的训练师。
你们的管理团队让我来和大家谈谈我们为所有全职员工提供的健康计划。
只需每月 15 美元，您就可以充分使用我们的设施。
您必须在 5 月 30 日之前加入健身中心，才能享受这些介绍性价格。
我正在分发一份报名表。
如果您有兴趣，请写下您的姓名和电子邮件地址，这样我可以给您发送信息。
